nodes.title: Place the chamber
nodes.description: Stand the clean, empty chamber upright on the bench.

feedback.retry: Review Place the chamber and try again.

nodes.title: Label the chamber
nodes.description: Write "2-Propanol" on the chamber's label tape with the pencil, so the trial keeps its solvent's name.

feedback.retry: Review Label the chamber and try again.

nodes.title: Measure the solvent
nodes.description: Pour {{config.solventVolumeMl}} mL of 2-propanol from its bottle into the graduated cylinder, reading the bottom of the meniscus.

feedback.retry: Review Measure the solvent and try again.

nodes.title: Pour the solvent into the chamber
nodes.description: Pour it into the chamber and let the cylinder drain. The layer must stay below where the baseline will hang.

feedback.success: Pour the solvent into the chamber complete.
feedback.retry: Review Pour the solvent into the chamber and try again.

nodes.title: Lay the strip flat
nodes.description: Lay a fresh strip flat on the bench. Handle it by its edges.

feedback.retry: Review Lay the strip flat and try again.

nodes.title: Draw the baseline
nodes.description: Draw a thin pencil line across the strip {{config.baselineHeightMm}} mm above its lower edge. Pencil, not ink: graphite does not run.

feedback.retry: Review Draw the baseline and try again.

nodes.title: Fill the capillary
nodes.description: Dip the capillary's tip into the dye mixture; it fills by capillary action.

feedback.retry: Review Fill the capillary and try again.

nodes.title: Spot 1 of 3
nodes.description: Touch the capillary's tip to the centre of the baseline, briefly, so the spot stays small.

feedback.retry: Review Spot 1 of 3 and try again.

nodes.title: Let spot 1 dry
nodes.description: Leave the strip flat until the spot is dry. The clock runs the wait ({{config.spotDryMinutes}} min) fast.

feedback.retry: Review Let spot 1 dry and try again.

nodes.title: Spot 2 of 3
nodes.description: Touch the tip to the same spot again, briefly.

feedback.retry: Review Spot 2 of 3 and try again.

nodes.title: Let spot 2 dry
nodes.description: Leave the strip flat until the spot is dry. The clock runs the wait ({{config.spotDryMinutes}} min) fast.

feedback.retry: Review Let spot 2 dry and try again.

nodes.title: Spot 3 of 3
nodes.description: Touch the tip to the same spot again, briefly.

feedback.retry: Review Spot 3 of 3 and try again.

nodes.title: Let spot 3 dry
nodes.description: Leave the strip flat until the spot is dry. The clock runs the wait ({{config.spotDryMinutes}} min) fast.

feedback.retry: Review Let spot 3 dry and try again.

nodes.title: Hang the strip from the hook
nodes.description: Hang the strip from the hook under the chamber's lid, spot end down, holding the lid above the chamber.

feedback.success: Hang the strip from the hook complete.
feedback.retry: Review Hang the strip from the hook and try again.

nodes.title: Lower the strip and seat the lid
nodes.description: Lower the strip in and seat the lid: its lower edge in the solvent, the spot above it, the strip clear of the walls.

validation.label: Lower the strip and seat the lid was completed.

feedback.success: Lower the strip and seat the lid complete.
feedback.retry: Review Lower the strip and seat the lid and try again.

nodes.title: Let the solvent rise
nodes.description: Leave the closed chamber undisturbed while the solvent climbs the strip, until its front reaches the stop distance. The clock runs the wait ({{config.developMinutes}} min) fast.

feedback.retry: Review Let the solvent rise and try again.

nodes.title: Lift the lid with the strip
nodes.description: Lift the lid straight up; the strip comes out with it.

validation.label: Lift the lid with the strip was completed.

feedback.success: Lift the lid with the strip complete.
feedback.retry: Review Lift the lid with the strip and try again.

nodes.title: Unhook the strip and lay it flat
nodes.description: Unhook the wet strip and lay it flat on the bench.

feedback.success: Unhook the strip and lay it flat complete.
feedback.retry: Review Unhook the strip and lay it flat and try again.

nodes.title: Mark the solvent front
nodes.description: At once, before it evaporates, draw a pencil line along the wet edge the solvent reached.

validation.label: Mark the solvent front was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Mark the solvent front and try again.

nodes.title: Let the strip dry
nodes.description: Leave it flat until it is dry: bands keep moving while it is wet. The clock runs the wait ({{config.stripDryMinutes}} min) fast.

validation.label: Let the strip dry was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Let the strip dry and try again.

nodes.title: Identify the bands
nodes.description: Record each band's colour, from the baseline up. Where bands run together, record the overlap as one region.

feedback.retry: Review Identify the bands and try again.

nodes.title: Lay the ruler along the strip
nodes.description: Lay the ruler beside the strip with its zero on the baseline.

feedback.success: Lay the ruler along the strip complete.
feedback.retry: Review Lay the ruler along the strip and try again.

nodes.title: Read the front
nodes.description: Read the distance from the baseline to the front's pencil line, to the nearest millimetre, and enter it.

feedback.retry: Review Read the front and try again.

nodes.title: Record the front
nodes.description: Record the front's distance in your data table.

feedback.retry: Review Record the front and try again.

nodes.title: Read the blue band
nodes.description: Read the distance from the baseline to the centre of the blue band, to the nearest millimetre, and enter it.

validation.label: Read the blue band was recorded.

feedback.retry: Review Read the blue band and try again.

nodes.title: Record the blue band
nodes.description: Record the band and its distance in your data table.

feedback.retry: Review Record the blue band and try again.

nodes.title: Read the red band
nodes.description: Read the distance from the baseline to the centre of the red band, to the nearest millimetre, and enter it.

validation.label: Read the red band was recorded.

feedback.retry: Review Read the red band and try again.

nodes.title: Record the red band
nodes.description: Record the band and its distance in your data table.

feedback.retry: Review Record the red band and try again.

nodes.title: Read the yellow band
nodes.description: Read the distance from the baseline to the centre of the yellow band, to the nearest millimetre, and enter it.

validation.label: Read the yellow band was recorded.

feedback.retry: Review Read the yellow band and try again.

nodes.title: Record the yellow band
nodes.description: Record the band and its distance in your data table.

feedback.retry: Review Record the yellow band and try again.

nodes.title: Calculate each band's Rf
nodes.description: Rf is the band's distance divided by the front's distance, both from the baseline. Work it out for each band from your recorded readings.

feedback.retry: Review Calculate each band's Rf and try again.

nodes.title: Record the separation
nodes.description: Record how well the bands separated: resolved, overlapping or streaked.

feedback.retry: Review Record the separation and try again.

nodes.title: Pour the 2-propanol into the waste
nodes.description: Pour the used 2-propanol into the organic waste beaker: never down the sink.

feedback.success: Pour the 2-propanol into the waste complete.
feedback.retry: Review Pour the 2-propanol into the waste and try again.

commonMistakes.when: current node expects a different action
commonMistakes.message: That action is out of sequence for the current technique step.
commonMistakes.recovery: Check the process map and perform the highlighted step first.

commonMistakes.when: source equipment or contents are missing
commonMistakes.message: The selected source does not contain the material required for this action.
commonMistakes.recovery: Select equipment that contains the required liquid, solid, solution, or precipitate.

commonMistakes.message: The target equipment cannot hold the requested volume.
commonMistakes.recovery: Use a larger container or transfer a smaller measured amount.
